title: Epic: Auto-generate loopback client_id query params for localhost development
description:
## Why
When developing locally with the AT Protocol OAuth spec, loopback clients must embed scope and redirect_uri as query parameters in the client_id URL (e.g., http://localhost?scope=atproto&redirect_uri=http://127.0.0.1:3000/callback). Currently the SDK requires developers to manually construct this URL, which is error-prone and creates unnecessary friction. The SDK should make local development as easy as possible.

## What success looks like
- When a user passes a bare localhost client_id (e.g., http://localhost or http://localhost/), the SDK automatically appends scope and redirect_uri query params from the existing config
- When a user passes a localhost client_id that already has query params, the SDK respects them (no double-appending)
- Non-localhost client_ids are completely unaffected
- The README local development example is simplified to show the easier DX
- Tests cover all edge cases

## Key constraints
- Only trigger on http://localhost (not 127.0.0.1, not ngrok, not any other host)
- Per AT Protocol spec: localhost client_id must have http scheme, hostname exactly 'localhost', no port
- Must not break existing configs where users already manually construct the query params
- The transformation happens before the client_id is passed to @atproto/oauth-client-node

## Scope
Changes in sdk-core only: OAuthClient.buildClientMetadata(), config validation, tests, README
close_reason: All 3 children closed. 797 tests pass, build green. Commits: cb5e41b (impl), 7780c08 (tests), 0c0bf6f (docs).

title: Add buildLoopbackClientId helper to auto-generate localhost client_id with query params
description:
## Files
- packages/sdk-core/src/auth/OAuthClient.ts (modify)

## What to do
Add a private method `buildLoopbackClientId(clientId: string, scope: string, redirectUri: string): string` to OAuthClient that:

1. Checks if the clientId is a bare localhost URL: scheme is `http`, hostname is exactly `localhost`, no port, path is `/` or empty, and **no existing query parameters**
2. If yes, constructs a new URL with query parameters:
   - `scope` param = hardcoded to `"atproto transition:generic"` (full dev access). **Ignore** whatever scope the user passed in config — for loopback clients, the scope embedded in client_id is what matters, and devs always want full access.
   - `redirect_uri` param = the oauth.redirectUri from config (URL-encoded)
   - Result looks like: `http://localhost?scope=atproto+transition%3Ageneric&redirect_uri=http%3A%2F%2F127.0.0.1%3A3000%2Fcallback`
3. If the clientId already has query parameters (user manually constructed it), return it unchanged
4. If the clientId is not a localhost URL at all, return it unchanged

Call this method at the top of `buildClientMetadata()` to transform `this.config.oauth.clientId` before using it. Store the result and use it for the `client_id` field in the metadata object.

Log an info message when auto-generating: "Loopback client detected — auto-generating client_id with scope and redirect_uri query parameters. Using \"atproto transition:generic\" for scope as required by the AT Protocol OAuth spec for loopback clients."

If the user had passed a different scope in config, also log a warning: "Loopback client_id detected — overriding configured scope \"<user-scope>\" with \"atproto transition:generic\" as required by the AT Protocol OAuth spec for loopback clients."

Also update the `scope` field in the returned metadata object to match `"atproto transition:generic"` when auto-generating, so the metadata is internally consistent.

## Dont
- Do NOT modify the original config object (this.config) — only transform values locally in buildClientMetadata
- Do NOT trigger on 127.0.0.1 or [::1] — only on exactly "localhost" hostname per AT Protocol spec
- Do NOT trigger if the URL has a port number (AT Protocol spec says localhost client_id must not have a port)
- Do NOT add any new dependencies
acceptance_criteria:
1. When config has clientId="http://localhost" or "http://localhost/", scope="atproto" (or any scope), redirectUri="http://127.0.0.1:3000/callback", the metadata.client_id should contain scope=atproto+transition%3Ageneric (or equivalent URL-encoded form) and the redirect_uri param
2. The metadata.scope should also be "atproto transition:generic" when auto-generating
3. When the user scope differs from "atproto transition:generic", a warning log is emitted mentioning "as required by the AT Protocol OAuth spec for loopback clients"
4. When config has clientId="http://localhost?scope=custom&redirect_uri=http://127.0.0.1:3000/cb", the metadata.client_id should be unchanged (already has query params)
5. When config has clientId="https://example.com/client-metadata.json", the metadata.client_id should be unchanged
6. When config has clientId="http://localhost:3000", the metadata.client_id should be unchanged (has port)
7. An info log is emitted when auto-generating mentioning "as required by the AT Protocol OAuth spec"
8. pnpm --filter @hypercerts-org/sdk-core test passes
9. pnpm --filter @hypercerts-org/sdk-core build passes
close_reason: cb5e41b Completed: auto-generate loopback client_id query params for localhost dev

title: Refactor: reuse isLoopbackUrl in buildLoopbackClientId and buildClientMetadata
description:
## Files
- packages/sdk-core/src/auth/OAuthClient.ts (modify)
- packages/sdk-core/tests/auth/OAuthClient.test.ts (modify)

## What to do

### Change 1: buildLoopbackClientId (line ~179-221)
Replace the custom `isBareLocalhost` check with the existing `isLoopbackUrl()` from `../lib/url-utils.js` (already imported at line 4).

Current code (lines 189-194):
```typescript
const isBareLocalhost =
  url.protocol === "http:" &&
  url.hostname === "localhost" &&
  !url.port &&
  (url.pathname === "/" || url.pathname === "") &&
  url.search === "";
```

Replace with:
```typescript
const isBareLoopback = isLoopbackUrl(clientId) && !url.port && (url.pathname === "/" || url.pathname === "") && url.search === "";
```

This reuses `isLoopbackUrl` for the scheme+hostname check (covers localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]) and only adds the extra checks for "bare" (no port, no path, no query params). Note: 127.0.0.1 and [::1] as client_id wont actually work with AT Protocol auth servers, but thats the auth servers problem — the SDK should still try to be helpful and auto-generate params for any loopback URL the user passes.

### Change 2: buildClientMetadata scope detection (line ~271)
Current code:
```typescript
const isAutoGeneratedLoopback = clientId !== this.config.oauth.clientId;
```

This is fragile — it fails if the user passes a loopback URL with their own query params (the URLs would differ but it wasnt auto-generated). Replace with:
```typescript
const isAutoGeneratedLoopback = isLoopbackUrl(clientId) && clientId !== this.config.oauth.clientId;
```

This way, the scope override to "atproto transition:generic" only happens when BOTH conditions are true: the clientId is a loopback URL AND it was transformed by buildLoopbackClientId.

### Change 3: Update tests
- The test "should not modify localhost client_id with port" should be removed or updated — with isLoopbackUrl, `http://localhost:3000` IS a loopback URL, but it has a port so buildLoopbackClientId still wont auto-generate (the `!url.port` check remains). So this test should still pass as-is. Verify it does.
- Add a new test: "should auto-append params for http://127.0.0.1 client_id" — config with clientId="http://127.0.0.1", verify the auto-generation info log IS emitted (since isLoopbackUrl covers 127.0.0.1).
- Add a new test: "should not override scope when user passes loopback with own query params" — config with clientId="http://localhost?scope=atproto&redirect_uri=http://127.0.0.1:3000/cb", verify NO scope override warning is emitted.

## Dont
- Do NOT remove the `!url.port`, `url.pathname`, or `url.search` checks — those are still needed to detect "bare" loopback URLs
- Do NOT change the isLoopbackUrl function itself
- Do NOT change any other files
acceptance_criteria:
1. buildLoopbackClientId uses isLoopbackUrl() instead of manual hostname check
2. buildClientMetadata uses isLoopbackUrl(clientId) && clientId !== this.config.oauth.clientId for scope detection
3. Existing 7 loopback tests still pass
4. New test for http://127.0.0.1 auto-generation passes
5. New test for user-provided loopback query params (no scope override) passes
6. pnpm --filter @hypercerts-org/sdk-core test passes
7. pnpm --filter @hypercerts-org/sdk-core build passes
8. pnpm lint passes

title: Epic: Fix imageToUrl to pass through all valid URI schemes, not just http(s)
description:
## Why
imageToUrl in ProfileOperationsImpl.ts only treats http:// and https:// URIs as passthrough, converting everything else to a blob URL via getBlobUrl. This means valid non-http URIs like ipfs://, at://, data:// etc. are incorrectly treated as bare CIDs and mangled into blob URLs.

## What success looks like
- Any string returned by extractCidFromImage that is a valid URI (has a scheme) is returned unchanged
- Only bare CIDs (no scheme) are passed to getBlobUrl
- The existing isValidUri utility from src/lib/url-utils.ts is reused
- Existing error throw for falsy extractCidFromImage result is preserved
- Tests cover non-http URI schemes (ipfs://, at://, data://)

## Scope
Single method change + test updates in sdk-core

title: Use isValidUri in imageToUrl to pass through all valid URI schemes instead of only http(s)
